messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync — I'm putting together the API roadmap item for auth & tenant controls. want to align on scope: api keys, org/project scoping, rotation, and how rotation affects long-lived streams/tool calls.
ashwin (Eng): +1. main concerns: backward compat for existing keys, streaming sessions (SSE/ws) that hold a key for minutes/hours, and function/tool callers that might cache keys.
jen (Security): We need to define key types: org-admin, project-service, ephemeral session tokens. rotation semantics differ for each. also audit log requirements + ksm/KMS integration.
sam (DevEx): From SDKs perspective, ephemeral tokens + automatic refresh are easiest for users. We should expose a refresh endpoint and a short-lived token pattern.
nashwin (Eng): Proposal sketch:
- API key model: {org_key, project_key, service_key, ephemeral_token}
- Default behavior: project-scoped keys for normal usage; org_key only for org-level admin actions.
- Rotation: support immediate revoke + grace window (e.g., 5m for live streams) and server-sent challenge to rotate in-flight if client supports.
jen (Security): Danger: grace window must be configurable by org. also rotation must create an audit event with old_key_id, new_key_id, actor.
maria (PM): Launch criteria idea:
- spec + API contract doc approved
- SDKs support automatic refresh + sample app updated
- console UI for key creation/rotation + audit view
- integration tests for streams + function-calling on rotation
- security review signoff
ashwin (Eng): On technical impact: in-flight stream handling options:
1) force close streams on revoke (simpler) -> breaks apps
2) send "rotate" event prompting client to get new token -> needs protocol change but smoother
3) allow grace period on server-side token acceptance -> simplest for users but increases attack window
Which do we prefer?
jen (Security): I'd push for 2 + short grace. Protocol change ok if documented; fallback 3 if client doesn't support rotate.
sam (DevEx): We should also provide a client helper that automatically exchanges an ephemeral token, transparent to apps. example snippet in SDK:```js
// pseudo
const client = new Redwood({auth: {type: 'ephemeral', refreshEndpoint: '/v1/auth/refresh'}})
client.on('rotate', async () => { await client.refreshToken() })
```
infra-bot: perf note: rotation checks on every request add overhead. prefer token validation with cached key material + TTL.
ops-bot: deploys for auth service will touch 3 services: auth-api, token-cache, streaming-gateway. plan a canary rollout.
maria (PM): Prioritization / roadmap phases (draft):
- Phase 1 (MVP): project/org keys, console create/revoke, API for rotate, audit events. minimal streaming grace support (5m).
- Phase 2: ephemeral tokens + SDK automatic refresh + rotate event protocol + UI for service accounts.
- Phase 3: per-route scoping, key policies (rate limits, model/route restrictions), cross-tenant delegation (service-to-service).
jen (Security): Add requirement: key rotation must integrate with KMS/HSM for private deployments; on-prem we need offline rotation docs + operator CLI.
nashwin (Eng): Tradeoffs for Phase 1: faster launch but more customer support tickets. For enterprise customers we can offer managed rotation assistance.
sam (DevEx): Launch docs checklist: API reference, migration guide for existing keys, SDK examples for refresh/rotate, troubleshooting (common errors e.g., 401 during rotation).
maria (PM): Customer-driven asks: two large customers asked for project-scoped read-only keys and an admin org-key with audit-only access. we'll prioritize read-only project keys in Phase 1.
nashwin (Eng): Implementation notes: token format we discussed (kid, scope, exp). We'll store key metadata in auth-db and cache public key material in token-cache for validation. Need endpoints: POST /v1/keys (create), POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate, POST /v1/keys/:id/revoke, GET /v1/keys (list).
jen (Security): Also add: support for key labels, expiration policy, and a bulk-rotate API for org admins.
sam (DevEx): UX ask: console should show which keys affect streaming vs non-streaming clients and recommended rotation windows. short copy: "Rotation may interrupt active streams unless client supports rotation protocol."
maria (PM): OK next steps: ashwin please write a short tech spec with endpoints + rotation states by EOD Friday. jen please add security controls & KMS notes. sam please draft SDK refresh API. I'll consolidate and propose prioritization by Monday. @ashwin @jen @sam :thumbsup:
ashwin (Eng): will do.
jen (Security): on it.
sam (DevEx): working on examples.
infra-bot: scheduled job: auth-db migration draft created (ticket #3421).
ops-bot: FYI: will schedule canary windows once spec posted.
